description: One integration test drives lead 008 from the posted queue to `quote_sent` against the leadgen and mailbox containers, with the reply read from a recording. Expect: all pass.
After that run the mailbox holds exactly one request and one quote packet for lead 008. Expect: `1 1`.
command: curl -s http://localhost:8025/leads/LEAD-00000042-008/emails | jq -r '[(map(select(.metadata.kind == "routine_request" or .metadata.kind == "sensitive_request")) | length), (map(select(.metadata.kind == "quote_packet")) | length)] | join(" ")'

description: The running app serves the queue and lead 008's detail from live data. Expect: `true`, then `true`.
command: curl -s http://localhost:8000/api/leads | jq -e 'map(.lead_id) | index("LEAD-00000042-008") != null' && curl -s http://localhost:8000/api/leads/LEAD-00000042-008 | jq -e '.lead_id == "LEAD-00000042-008" and (.facts | length) > 0'
